notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
You have been waiting for an update and now this day has come.
What's new:
1)Added skins, at the moment they are 4 pieces, 3 skins you can get just by playing the game, but the coolest "Galaxy Skin" will get only those who were able to pass the game. This skin is issued only 1 time and will be of great value.
To skin was available in the game, it must be in your inventory steam.
2) Added music volume down button.
3) Minor game improvements.
4) Sorry, old saves won't work. Please accept our apologies.
5)Removed the side view.
In the future, our team will add new skins. Stay tuned and write your wishes to improve the game. Our deep in the canal https://discord.gg/HHSdYkF

notes.title: Global update of the game!!!
notes.content:
ADDED ITEM DROP SYSTEM FOR TIME SPENT IN THE GAME!
Now you can get a random thing just by playing the game.
So far, these things can not be used in the game, but in the future we will implement it.
Added 4 skins.
To get the thing you need to stay in the game 30 minutes.
The maximum per day, you can knock out 2 things.
Things can be sold on the trading floor.
If you stayed in the game for 30 minutes and did not get the thing, then go to the game and in the first minutes you will get your item.
Definitely when you got a thing, you reconnect to the game, otherwise you will not fall a second thing.
More things will be added in the future.
You can suggest what things or skin to add in discussions.
Enjoy the game.
